sections.text_helper: Section 31.1 "DLYB introduction" in chapter 31 (Delay block (DLYB)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1456.
sections.section_content:
The delay block (DLYB) is used to generate two output clocks that are dephased from 2
input clocks. The phase of each output clock must be programmed by the user application.
The output clocks are then used to clock the data transmitted/received by another
peripheral such as an SDMMC.
